answer: Sequential challenge ladders. Each identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated task chain whose answer depends on the agent's private key and a violet-seeded nonce; answers are single-use and expire, so no thread of solved challenges can be replayed. An identity reaches its nadir of trust at chain start and climbs only by solving in real time. Cloning pays full compute per identity per epoch, and copied answers fail verification, forcing linear marginal cost.
